name: jacobi2d
signature: void jacobi2d(long tsteps, long n, double *A, double *B)
layout: A and B are n x n matrices stored row-major: element (i, j) is at index i*n + j. Both are input and output: the function updates them starting from their initial values. Only interior elements (1 <= i, j <= n-2) are written; the border rows and columns of both arrays are fixed boundary values. A and B do not overlap. n is at least 3 and tsteps is at least 1.
